recipes.name: Spinach and Artichoke Dip
ingredients_raw: 1 (14 ounce) can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 1-quart baking dish.
Combine artichoke hearts, spinach, and mayonnaise in a bowl; mix in 2 cups Monterey Jack, then mix in Parmesan. Transfer to the prepared baking dish and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup Monterey Jack.
Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted, about 15 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Spinach and Artichoke Dip
raw_recipe.description: This easy spinach and artichoke dip is sure to be a hit at your next party. It's creamy, cheesy, and oh-so-good on crackers, pita chips, or toasted bread.

review.reviewBody: This dip is a hit at every party. To keep it soft and easy to dip for large parties, I dont bake it, but instead mix it up and put it in a crockpot set on warm with chips on the side. This dip is better than what most restaurants serve. Thanks for the great recipe!!

Very good, easy and quick although I did make a couple of alterations. I used a bag of fresh baby spinach, sautéed in butter and garlic. Mixed with the remaining ingredients and then added a few shakes of hot pepper sauce. Served it in a small crockpot instead of baking in oven. Really good with garlic parmesan Italian toasts.

I added 2 garlic cloves chopped,I also used half cup mayonnaise, 1/2 cup cream cheese, and instead of Monterey Jack cheese, I used Queso Chihuahua quesadilla cheese...I put it in the crock pot on low for 1 hour, it came out fabulous, once the cheese on top is melted, it's done.

I agree this is an amazing dip. I followed some of the tips in the comments, such as: 1/2 cup mayo & 1/2 cup sour cream instead of 1 full cup mayo. Added salt, pepper, powdered garlic & minced garlic. One of the times I made it, I used fresh spinach which I sauteed prior to mixing with the other ingredients. Both versions were VERY well received!! Thank you!

Yum! I couldn’t find Colby Jack Cheese in the store I went to so I used mozzarella cheese in place of it. I also prepared it and let it sit in the fridge for two days before making it. It came out great! Thanks for such an easy delicious recipe! I know what I am taking to my next food event or potluck!

This dip was easy & quick to make, a winner as a "go to" appetizer prior to a casual dinner or just to enjoy with a glass of wine. I played with the cheese combination a bit, adding a little Romano Asiago blend to the Monterrey Jack that the recipe called for, Parmesan was added as per recipe. I added some dehydrated white onion bits, ground pepper and seasoned salt. The recipe yielded enough to split in 2, even 3 portions, freezing the remaining dip in small containers for later use.

We Love the La Terra Fina Spinach Artichoke Parmesan cold dip. This recipe is close. Here are the ingredients of that dip...Cream Cheese, Spinach, Mayonnaise, Onions, Artichokes, Monterey Jack cheese, Parmesan Cheese, Garlic, Sea salt, Sugar, Spices. So the missing ingredients, in my opinion, for a more flavorful dip are: Cream Cheese, onions, garlic, sea salt, sweetener and spice in that order.
Great base for dip but did need something more flavorful for us. We use pepperjack cheese instead of what it calls for and it gives the dip a perfect zing!

Huge hit at Xmas eve dinner! I added an extra can of artichoke hearts and a 1/2 cup of sour cream, simply because I had them and wanted to make a little more dip. So yummy! Those were my only changes.
I love this! I used 1/2 cup non fat plain yoghurt and only 1/4 cup of mayo. It took some of the fat out, but still tasted wonderful. MMM
Great recipe! I add garlic, salt and pepper. I also exchange the Monterey Jack for pepper Jack and it is a game changer. It is a favorite everywhere I go. I serve with fresh sourdough rounds

022126... i tried this one... on the vegitarians and the gluten free individual... it seemed to have been eaten and enjoyed by the veggies... as microsoft copilot said its a staple food for there kind... it recomends adding more to it or making it a topping to add more nutrients for the vegitarian kind... i did not observe the gluten free one eating the dish though... as for me the chef... it was easy enjoyable and quick to cook... i enjoy the minamlist recipes on this page... some say to add more to many of the recipes... but thats more cash and wastefull... overall 4 cause of that... but minimalism makes sense to me... even if its not as flavorful as wasteful is.
Oh so good! I added garlic powder and red pepper flakes. It was a bit thick so I may add a little sour cream next time. Will definitely be a next time.
My go-to recipe for hot spinach artichoke dip. I add salt, pepper and a dash of cayenne for a little extra zip. Pepper jack is also a good sub.

This is a family and friend favorite. I make it pretty much for every gathering and its gone in 60 seconds! The only modification I make- add garlic salt and pepper for more flavor. We also serve it on cucumbers or corn chips. A crowd pleaser for sure, thanks for sharing!
This recipe was really easy and it didn't take a ton of ingredients. I will make it again.
Friends & family love this dip!!
Looking yummy 😋 can't wait to eat it.
Family loves this
So simple and delicious to make. Gone so fast! Everyone asked for the recipe.
